name: Lusamia
region: Eastern Uganda (Busia, Samia-Bugwe, southern Tororo) and across the border into Busia County, Kenya
translator_note: Busia-town Lusamia in the Luhya (Saamia) orthography: okhu- infinitives, kh and ch, class prefixes omu-/aba-, esi-/ebi-, e-/chi-, olu-, akha-, ama-, the pronouns ese/ewe/efwe, and the Luhya greeting Mulembe on the welcome screen. Verbs: Nina (board), Kabana (share), Pangisa (rent), Ruma (send); Tira khu UG for Book, Khupa esimu for Call ahead, Runga for pay, Chaka for start. Busia speech mixes in Swahili and Luganda loans freely (app, boda, taxi, paaka, jaamu, karibu, sikaani, koodi, linki, kaadi, lisiiti, amapesa), and those are kept. The perfective passives (sia-...-ibwa versus -wa), the words for day (olunaku), truth (obwene), trust (obwisichi) and market (esoko), and every app-only term (plug-in, endpoint, API key, sandbox, concierge, arbitrage desk) are the least certain and are listed under uncertain.

strings.page.p.ug_speaks_the_languages: UG elomaloma chinimi chia Uganda, chia esitundu sino, ne chia abageni bayo. Lobola olulimi lwo; byoosi bilondelela.
strings.position: Bonekha obulayi. Runga ebeeyi ya obukesi.
strings.top.p.one_app_that_quotes: App ndala ekhulolesia chibeeyi chia buli lugendo mu esoko ya Uganda hambi ne hambi, ekabania olugendo lwa hale ne Prado ekhurungisia esitundu silala khu bine, ekhupangisia emotoka ni wenya okhuula obulayi, ne etira paaka chipaamiti nichisiri okhuwa. Orunga nga Kampala ng'erunga: amapesa ka khu esimu.
strings.doorRiderSub: Tira endebe, linganisa buli lugendo, panga wiikendi.
strings.doorDriverSub: Bola ha wenya okhuvuga. Chingendo chiarungwa chikhwitsira.

strings.top.div.prototype_v1_every_price: Esigesa v1 · buli beeyi ni okhubalirira okhurula mu nkola yahandikwa · okhurunga khukholwa mu esifwo sia okhugesa · hano khubula mpeereza yafuchiririrwa mu mateeka

strings.compare.summary.more_options_pick_the: Ebindi ebia okhulobola <small>lobola emotoka, efula, kabana</small>
strings.compare.summary.what_choosing_badly_cost: Okhulobola obubi khukhurungisia sina <small>ebanga lia chibeeyi mu esoko khu lugendo luno</small>
strings.compare.summary.the_atlas_every_way: Atlasi · buli ngira ya okhuchenda, mu lukalala lulala <small>endeke, ebaasi, amatsi, treni, chimotoka chia Signature, ha okona, ne obwene bwa embeera ya buli sindu</small>
strings.compare.p.book_on_ug_where: Tira khu UG ni engira eriho, Khupa esimu ni ebula, Siri khu lukalala okhusimanya, Sitsa khu ebirikhwa okhumbakhwa. Chibeeyi chibalirirwa ne chisibola.
strings.stage.div.the_virtual_stage_seats: Esiteegi ya khu esimu · chindebe chichaka okhwitsula, emotoka yitsa
strings.stage.h2.pay_for_the_seat: Runga endebe. Emotoka yitsa ni yitsuule.
strings.stage.p.like_a_matatu_stage: Nga esiteegi ya taxi, emotoka erula ni yitsuule namwe esaa niyuula. Nga ehalukhana ne esiteegi, orunga endebe oli khu sofa yo mungo, ebeeyi ya endebe yikha ni abandu bo bameta, ne omudereva osibukula amalire okhubola ari amanyire engira ino obulayi.
strings.stage.summary.where_stages_fill_fastest: Ha chisiteegi chitsula bwangu <small>Pulse · chindebe chiarungwa khu chimaapu chia obwisichi bwa abadereva, buli tauni</small>
strings.stage.summary.buses_on_this_corridor: Chibaasi khu ngira ino <small>esia okhwirukhiramo, hambi ne esiteegi</small>
strings.stage.p.every_corridor_also_has: Buli ngira eri ne chibaasi khandi. Linganisa chisaa chia okhurula chia chikampuni chindi ne chindi, lola paaka ha orulira, ne otire khu UG ni ekampuni efuchirira okhutira khu mutimbagano. Ni ebula, khusibola ne khukhuwa enamba ya okhukhupa, mu esifwo sia peesa eyikhakhola.
strings.stage.summary.empty_legs_the_return: Chindebe chia okhukalukha <small>chindebe chia olugendo lwa okhukalukha, 40% ya ebeeyi</small>
strings.stage.p.every_rental_with_driver: Buli motoka yapangiswa ne omudereva ne buli lugendo lwakabanwa luri ne engira ya okhukalukha. Olugendo lwa okhutsia nilutirwa, chindebe chia okhukalukha chichaka okhukusibwa.
strings.stage.summary.post_a_trip_of: Ra olugendo lwo, namwe lola ebeeyi ya endebe <small>Kabana · abandu bo, ebeeyi ya obwene ya engira yakabanwa mu chindebe</small>
strings.stage.h3.offer_a_seat_or: Wa endebe, namwe lola ebeeyi eyo endebe yenyekha okhurungwa
strings.stage.p.posted_trips_live_only: Chingendo chia ora chimenya mu bulawuza buno bwonyene okhuula ni winjira. Kabana elondelela engira eyo Pool app yamanyisia: chi-akawunti chiakakasibwa ne esimu, okhunyumya mu lugendo, ne okhuwa obubonero khu buli lubeka, ne ebikundi bia abandu abomanyire.
strings.rent.p.self_drive_by_the: Wivugire khu lunaku, ne omudereva khu esaa, namwe chimotoka chia Signature ni okhuula nikho esikhulu. Ebeeyi eba ya buli mundu ni okabana.
strings.deliver.h2.send_the_thing_any: Ruma esindu. Obunene bwoosi, ehale yoosi.
strings.deliver.p.every_courier_in_town: Chikampuni chioosi chiruma ebindu mu tauni, khu esikuliini silala, chilondekhana. Hale ne Kampala, epakati echenda mu buuti ya emotoka ya esiteegi khu esitundu silala khu bine sia endebe, ne mu ebise bia okhukesa, taxi, pikapu namwe loole ne omudereva.
strings.deliver.p.courier_rates_are_ug: Chibeeyi chia abarumi ni okhubalirira khwa UG okhurula mu nkola yahandikwa; 8 to 8 e Jinja elangwa okhurula mu biragiro bia omuchaki ne ebeeyi yayo ebalirirwa. Epakati khu Esiteegi ni ebeeyi ya UG yene: esitundu silala khu bine sia endebe khu esiteegi eyo, erungwa omudereva halala ne chindebe.
strings.explore.div.explore_the_pearl_priced: Chenda · Luulu ya Afirika, khu ebeeyi ya obwene
strings.explore.h2.the_whole_park_weekend: Wiikendi yoosi mu paaka, enamba ndala.
strings.explore.p.park_entry_permits_vehicle: Okhwinjira paaka, chipaamiti, amapesa ka emotoka, lodge, amapesa ka rolex ne engira ya okhutsiayo, bibalirirwa abandu ba East Africa, abageni abamenya hano ne abageni abachenda. Abandu ba East Africa barunga chibeeyi chia East Africa.
strings.explore.summary.chain_a_whole_day: Panga olunaku lwoosi <small>Hustle Mode · buli situndu sia olugendo sibalirirwa khu ngira eyangu okhukira eyo ekhwana; wallet ne emipango bia okhugesa</small>
strings.explore.div.ug_wallet_sandbox_balance: UG Wallet · amapesa ka okhugesa, kasiri ka obwene
strings.drive.h2.say_where_you_are: Bola ha omanyire obulayi, lulala. Fuchirira chimotoka chitsuule.
strings.drive.p.no_posting_no_waiting: Khubula okhura, khubula okhulinda khu esiteegi, khubula okhuhakana khu ebeeyi. Emaapu yo ya Obwisichi nisio esindu sionyene osilinda: ha orula, ehale, chingira, chisaa, ne ebia oloba khaani. Ebirikhwa biarungwa bitsa ne amapesa kari mu bio.
strings.drive.summary.where_demand_is_coming: Ha abandu benya chingendo wiiki ino <small>Foresight · okhukesa, ebise bia ebifwo ne ebikholwa, wiiki ndala embeli, buli sika sia emotoka</small>
strings.drive.p.promise_to_be_there: Laka okhuba eyo, ebanga efunda khu buli mundu. Obwisichi bulolesibwa khu buli khabonero; ebise bia omwaka biri mateeka okhuula okhukesa khwa okhuchaka khubiyekesia.
strings.drive.span.confidence_is_shown_per: Obwisichi bulolesibwa khu buli khabonero; ebise bia omwaka biri mateeka okhuula ni chingendo chitsuule chia okhwiyekesiamo chiriho.
strings.install.h2.the_site_is_the: Esaiti ni app. Era khu esimu, namwe sikaani koodi.
strings.install.p.one_link_on_the: Linki ndala khu mutimbagano ne khu esimu: akawunti ndala, chisiteegi chilala, Crest ndala khu esikuliini sia mungo. Khubula okhutsia mu sitoowa.
strings.install.p.scan_with_the_camera: Sikaani ne kamera. Koodi yikula linki ino yene; injira ne enamba ndala, byoosi biri hano.
strings.install.p.ride_pool_rent_deliver: Nina. Kabana. Pangisa. Ruma. Esoko ya okhuchenda ya Uganda ya abandu abari ne ha batsia ne bajeti ya okhulinda.

Khubolere esinyala okhuyeeta: hello@ug.example.
strings.ops.p.every_town_on_the: Buli tauni khu emaapu ni engira okhurula Kampala ne esiteegi yayo yene. Ha app ya habundu yakhola, UG ewa eyo esitundu sia okhumalirikha mu esifwo sia okhwikhola nga eriho.
strings.ops.div.plug_ins_ug_talks: Ebiyungwakho · UG elomaloma ne ebikholesibwa ebia okholesia
strings.ops.h2.maps_from_felt_climate: Chimaapu okhurula khu Felt. Chinkola chia embeera ya esibala okhurula khu Infrared City. Ebia okhwisangasia okhurula khu Tazama. Okhufuga nikhubula amakhono okhurula khu Cephable.
strings.ops.p.each_plug_in_is: Buli siyungwakho ni siyunga siri ne anwani yasio ne esisumuluso siasio, bibikhwa khu esyuma sino okhuula ni winjira. Yunga silala, chipeesa chikhwana chiaka mu Kabana, Chenda ne Hustle Mode. Khubula sirula mu UG nisibula siyungwakho sia wakoleesia.
strings.ops.h2.competitors_are_listed_on: Abahakani barwa khu lukalala khu bwene. Omuchendi owisicha okhulinganisa akalukha khu okhukabana ne okhupangisa.
strings.ops.p.ug_is_a_marketplace: UG ni esoko okhuchaka. Chi-app chia okhulanga chimotoka chinyoola ebitirwa biitsuule nichibula okhurunga okhunyoola bakasitoma. Abapangisi ba chimotoka banyoola abapangisi ba wiikendi abakheberwa. Chilodge chinyoola ebikundi biuula khu lunaku lumanyikhane. Abadereva banyoola engira yitsuule nibasiri okhurula.
strings.ops.p.verified_drivers_and_plates: Abadereva ne chinamba chia chimotoka chiakakasibwa, SOS mu lugendo ekabana ha ori bulaano ne omundu owe walobola, chinkofira khu buli boda yakabanwa, ne lisiiti khu buli silingi.
strings.ops.h3.for_drivers_and_yards: Khu abadereva ne abapangisi ba chimotoka
strings.ops.p.ten_percent_on_pool: Ekhumi khu buli mia khu okhukabana, amapesa kalala ka okhura emotoka khu okhupangisa, okhurungwa buli wiiki khu MoMo khubira mu Flutterwave, ne bakasitoma abo okhalanga okhulangira.
strings.ops.p.deep_links_that_open: Chilinki chiikula app yo ne ha obukulwa ne ha oleekhwa biitsuule. Khukhalolesia ebeeyi eyo khukhabalirira mu lwatu ta, ne engira yahandikwa.

strings.ui.reviewNote: Chinkyusa chiahandikwa UG ne chikheberwa lwa khabiri; okhukhebera khwa abene olulimi khusiri okhwikula. Ebirimo ebibula bikalukha mu Lungereza.
